notes: Trigger-accuracy eval set for the SKILL.md description, per https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/optimizing-descriptions. The split is fixed: revise the description against `train` only, and score iterations by the `validation` pass rate so improvements are measured on queries the description was never tuned against. Negatives are deliberately near-misses — they share vocabulary with the skill but need something else — because obviously-irrelevant negatives test nothing.
